extraction_notes: Main-text measured NH3-synthesis performance appears in Figure 2. Figure 5 panels were skipped because they are Arrhenius and reaction-order/kinetic plots, as instructed. Figure 2b includes a BaO-Co/C* literature bar from ref 15; that bar was skipped because it was not measured in this work. For several near-baseline series in Figure 2a (10%Co/CNTs, BaH2, and low-temperature BaO-Co/CNTs), the plotted values are indistinguishable at the published scale, so values are approximate baseline readings.
